name: f4-clip-editor
description: F4 Studio — local-first video editor and dedicated audio studio
author: @f4did

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-rollup-wasm.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ffmpeg-core.mjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop start
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:portable
scripts.desktop:store: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:store
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:linux
scripts.package:offline: npm run build && npm --prefix desktop install && npm --prefix desktop run dist:dir && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-offline.ps1
